plan.title: [framework-gap] Admit same-repo Claude/Directive linked worktrees under host-hook root check (split from #7349)

narratives.Description: Same-repo Claude linked worktrees and Directive dest worktrees are refused when launchRoot is primary and payloadRoot is the worktree. This activation records Prefer-A Bound so a later product PR can admit matching gitCommonDir before path-only rootsMatch refuse.
narratives.Overview:
- relieves: P1 — Admit when launch and payload gitCommonDir match before path-only rootsMatch refuse
- relieves: P2 — Cover primary-launched hook with same-repo worktree payload (Claude WT and Directive dest) in regression
- relieves: P3 — Keep mismatch recovery for true cross-repo / unresolved-common-dir; do not claim same-repo needs disable
narratives.Constraint:
- Rebind-only or prep-every-host-WT as the sole fix
- Admitting when either gitCommonDir is null/unresolved
- Admitting foreign-runtime-link
- #7349 / #7352 / #7029 scope
narratives.UserStory: As an operator, I want same-repo Claude and Directive linked worktrees admitted under the host-hook root check, so that tools work without disabling host hooks.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Edit packages/runtime/src/hook-dispatch.ts (and packages/core/src/session/git.ts helpers) to admit when launch and payload gitCommonDir match before path-only rootsMatch refuse.
2. Cover Claude WT and Directive dest positive cases plus cross-repo and foreign-runtime deny in packages/runtime/src/hook-dispatch.test.ts and packages/runtime/src/hook-dispatch-worktree.test.ts.
3. Verify with pnpm exec vitest on those files; keep product changelog fragments with the product PR, not this activation.

**Prefer admit same-repo** for the host-hook root check.

When `launchRoot` and `payloadRoot` differ by path but resolve to the **same Git repository** (same worktree family / common gitdir), admit the tool. Keep deny for other-repo and foreign-runtime-link.

- Same-repo linked worktrees (Claude `.claude/worktrees/` and Directive dests) pass the root check under that guarded predicate
- Launch checkout remains the policy/runtime authority unless a later Bound says otherwise
- Keep-outs: #7349 (escape hatch B), #7352 (MCP matcher), #7029 (`core.hooksPath`)
- Reject: rebind-only as sole fix; prep-every-host-WT as sole fix; widening past same-repo

## In plain English

Claude and swarm often launch hooks from the main checkout while tools run in a linked worktree of the **same** repo. Directive compares the two folder paths and refuses every tool. Operator lean is to **admit same-repo** worktrees under a guarded check, and keep denying other repos and foreign runtimes. Escape-hatch honesty (#7349) and MCP matcher (#7352) stay out of this arc.

## Pains

- P1: Strict `rootsMatch(launchRoot, payloadRoot)` hard-refuses when paths differ even though both are linked worktrees of one repository (Claude `.claude/worktrees/` and Directive dests).
- P2: #6767 locator only helps when the hook process cwd is already inside a seeded worktree; primary-launched sessions with worktree payload stay locked (tip 0.131.5 repro on #7349).
- P3: Recovery text pushes disable / new session / open-WT-as-root and does not offer a same-repo admission path, so wave spawn cannot keep host hooks on.

## Keep-outs

- #7349 — disable-host-hooks / repair strip honesty (Prefer-A ingest-ready)
- #7352 — host MCP/UI matcher overbreadth
- #7029 — `core.hooksPath` absolute inheritance

- Parent split / tip / OP evidence on #7349 thread
- Live gate: `packages/runtime/src/hook-dispatch.ts` AC9.4 `rootsMatch` before policy; `gitCommonDir` already used elsewhere for same-repo admits

Accept Prefer-A Bound as written. The three supplied comments describe a reachable remedy for each pain:

- P1: Compare resolved, canonical gitCommonDir values before the path-mismatch refusal. Requiring both values to resolve and match admits linked worktrees without admitting unrelated repositories.
- P2: That comparison uses launch and payload roots, so admission does not depend on the hook process already running inside the worktree. The proposed primary-launch regression cases cover both named worktree forms.
- P3: Successful same-repo admission removes the refusal that sends these calls toward disable or rebinding. Recovery remains for cross-repo and unresolved identity; it need not tell admitted same-repo calls to disable protection.

The explicit foreign-runtime-link denial remains mandatory even when repository identity matches. Keeping launch-checkout pin, policy, and runtime authority avoids adding an authority-selection mechanism. This is a narrow predicate change consistent with KISS and Thin Fail-Closed; no mechanism gap is apparent in the supplied design. ## In plain English

Prefer-A Bound 7171663570 resolves all three target pains (P1, P2, P3) through a clean, reachable, thin fail-closed mechanism. By admitting tool calls when `launchRoot` and `payloadRoot` resolve to matching canonical `gitCommonDir` paths, valid same-repo worktree invocations are admitted before the path-only `rootsMatch` check hard-refuses. The remedy preserves fail-closed security for cross-repo and foreign-runtime links, keeps launch checkout as the policy authority, and strictly respects all declared keep-outs (#7349, #7352, #7029).

## Pain relief assessment

- **pain-P1** (relieved): The hard refusal caused by `!rootsMatch(launchRoot, projectRoot)` is bypassed when both roots resolve to matching canonical `gitCommonDir` values. This directly admits same-repo linked worktrees (such as `.claude/worktrees/` and Directive dests) without weakening root protection against unrelated folders.
- **pain-P2** (relieved): Primary-launched sessions targeting a worktree payload are fully admitted under the shared `gitCommonDir` predicate, eliminating the limitation where the #6767 locator only functioned when process cwd was already within a seeded worktree. Explicit regression coverage locks primary-launch handling for both Claude worktrees and Directive dests.
- **pain-P3** (relieved): Valid same-repo worktree invocations will no longer trigger false refusal guidance that instructs operators to disable hooks, restart sessions, or open worktrees as root. Honest mismatch recovery is retained for true cross-repo calls and unresolved `gitCommonDir` cases.

## Mechanism & boundary check (KISS / Thin Fail-Closed)

- **Fail-closed guarantees**: Tool admission requires that both `launchRoot` and `payloadRoot` resolve a non-null `gitCommonDir` and that both match under canonical path comparison. True cross-repo invocations, foreign-runtime links, and unresolved git directories continue to be denied.
- **Authority intact**: Launch checkout remains the sole pin, policy, and runtime authority; payload does not seize authority.
- **Keep-outs honored**: No modifications to disable-hook repair honesty (#7349), MCP matchers (#7352), or `core.hooksPath` inheritance (#7029).
- **Reachable mechanism**: Directly utilizes existing canonicalization and `gitCommonDir` resolution logic in `packages/core/src/session/git.ts` and gate checks in `packages/runtime/src/hook-dispatch.ts`.

## Verdict

metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

Split from #7349 (slice A). A Claude Code (or swarm) session launched from the **primary** checkout with tool `cwd` / payload in a **same-repo** linked worktree — including host paths under `.claude/worktrees/<name>` — is refused on every tool:

```
payload project root does not match the launching checkout
(payloadRoot=<repo>/.claude/worktrees/<name> launchRoot=<repo>)
```

#6767 / #6594 claimed locator alignment when the hook process already runs inside a seeded worktree. Tip check on 0.131.5 still deny when `launchRoot` is primary and payload is the Claude worktree. Wave-4 worker spawn hits this layout.

## Expected

Same-repo linked worktrees (host `.claude/worktrees/` and Directive dest worktrees) are admitted under a guarded root check, **or** the product deliberately rebinds/preps so launchRoot always equals payloadRoot for that host model. Foreign-runtime / other-repo mismatch stays deny.

## Keep-outs

- Escape-hatch honesty (`disable-host-hooks` strip / repair disclosure) — owned by #7349 Prefer-A Bound (ingest-ready)
- MCP / host-UI matcher narrowing — sibling split (file with this issue)
- #7029 `core.hooksPath` absolute inheritance

## Evidence

- #7349 body + OP https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/7349#issuecomment-7170453136
- Tip repro comment https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/7349#issuecomment-7170507934
- Related: #6594, #6767, #6599 / #6607

## Design note

Prefer-A fork still open: **admit** same-repo vs **rebind** vs **prep-every-WT**. Recommend discuss lean before arc.

expected_outputs: same-repo gitCommonDir admit before path rootsMatch refuse
Claude WT and Directive dest positive regressions; cross-repo and foreign-runtime still deny
